Country.evidence_source: This project was approved by the Institutional Review Board of (Hagaman et al. 2017) and the Nepal Health Research Council. Additional permissions were granted by the National Nepal Police Headquarters and all relevant lower units.

Type.evidence_source: Researchers sought informed consent in Nepali from each participant before the interview.

Area.evidence_source: The study team and partner organization had a robust referral system established for survey participants endorsing distress. In these cases, participants were offered counseling and follow-up care.
